Local knowledge

Working locally for so long means we know the area. Many homes around Ruislip, Eastcote and Pinner are 1920s and 1930s semi-detached and terraced houses, where the front garden is often turned into a driveway. Northwood and parts of Pinner have larger detached homes with bigger gardens. Harrow, Wembley and Watford have a real mix. Whatever your home, we will design a driveway, patio or fence that suits it.
